chapters.title: I. The Royal Audience
chapters.narration: In Alsperia, the wizard Algoreth Jon Goren seeks the lost scrolls of Byzantem. Edmon, the kingdom's original king, and his wife, Queen Alisande, may know the road to Lorian.

beats.speaker: Archivist Mara
beats.text: Dorian the Seer was the scrolls' last keeper. He went west through Mistwood. The Caverns of Lorian hold the scrolls, but the old trail is lost.

journal.text: Archivist Mara says Dorian travelled west through Mistwood. Find his route and recover the Scrolls of Byzantem from the Caverns of Lorian.

beats.speaker: King Edmon
beats.text: A map, a horse, and a night's shelter are yours. Bring back knowledge that may aid Alsperia.

beats.speaker: Queen Alisande
beats.text: Power travels with obligation, Master Goren. Remember whose trust opens this road.

chapters.title: I. The Royal Audience — Scholar's Gallery
chapters.narration: The royal archive preserves Dorian's route in a damaged index. The missing marks can be recovered from a scholar's rubbing.

beats.speaker: Scholar Inessa
beats.text: The index was scraped where the western landmarks should be. I can restore it if we compare the court copy with the market ledger.

beats.speaker: Algoreth
beats.text: The recovered marks agree with Dorian's account. We have a route to Mistwood, though the waystones may have shifted.

routes.text: Inessa's copied index matches the pale stones. We can skirt the ruined watchpost if the road is watched.

chapters.title: II. Through Mistwood
chapters.narration: The royal map carries Algoreth into Mistwood. Old waystones promise a safe route, while unseen watchers stir beyond the trees.

beats.speaker: Scout Tessa
beats.text: I know this road. The moss hides snares; follow the pale stones and keep your spellbook ready.

journal.text: The party has reached Mistwood. Mara’s ledger and Inessa’s copied index can guide them along the pale stones toward Lorian.

beats.speaker: Tessa
beats.text: These tracks circle us. Something from the ruins hunts travellers after dusk.

beats.speaker: Dorian's inscription
beats.text: The path between worlds answers neither conquest nor fear. Carry a question worth the crossing.

chapters.title: II. Through Mistwood — The Ruined Watchpost
chapters.narration: The old watchpost overlooks a split in the woodland road. Fresh charcoal marks point toward Lorian, while a lost courier waits among the fallen stones.

beats.speaker: Courier Pell
beats.text: A royal patrol passed at dawn. I found a charcoal rubbing under the stair, but the stalker kept me from carrying it onward.

beats.speaker: Scout Tessa
beats.text: The rubbing names the western arch. If we leave the watchpost standing, the next travellers may still find this road.

routes.text: You mark the watchpost for repair. Tessa copies the western arch into her field book.
You leave a warning for the next traveller and take the rubbing toward Lorian.

chapters.title: III. The Caverns of Lorian
chapters.narration: Within Lorian, an ancient Byzantem arch guards a silver chest. Dorian's warning follows Algoreth into the dark.

beats.speaker: Dorian the Seer
beats.text: I kept the scrolls hidden from kings and thieves alike. Tell me why you would open a way to another world.

beats.speaker: Dorian
beats.text: The chest is protected by an old guardian. It knows no ambition, only the duty to keep the door closed.

beats.speaker: Algoreth
beats.text: The silver lid yields. The scrolls of Byzantem hold the secret of world travelling. Algoreth carries them back toward Alsperia.

journal.text: Algoreth recovered the Scrolls of Byzantem from Lorian. The party turns back toward Alsperia to report what they found.

chapters.title: III. The Caverns of Lorian — The Seal Gallery
chapters.narration: Beyond the silver vault, a gallery of sealed niches tests whether the traveller can read the warning without breaking it.

beats.speaker: Dorian's inscription
beats.text: Three marks surround the arch: passage, return, and restraint. The door answers only when the keeper names what must remain closed.

beats.speaker: Algoreth
beats.text: The scrolls are secured for the return journey. No second gate will be opened on the strength of these pages alone.

routes.text: The gallery record names restraint as the keeper's answer. Algoreth leaves every sealed niche closed.
The gallery keeper refused passage. Algoreth leaves the warning unresolved and every niche closed.

chapters.title: IV. Return to Alsperia
chapters.narration: Algoreth returns from Lorian with the scrolls. King Edmon and Queen Alisande receive the wizard who travelled under their protection.

beats.speaker: King Edmon
beats.text: You found what you sought. Our map and horse carried you west; now tell us what Lorian has taught you.

beats.speaker: Queen Alisande
beats.text: Knowledge won in darkness deserves careful study. Alsperia will hear your account before any court decides what comes next.

beats.speaker: Algoreth
beats.text: The scrolls speak of travel between worlds. Their meaning will take time to master; for now I owe this court an honest account.

chapters.title: IV. Return to Alsperia — Council Chamber
chapters.narration: The court asks what the scrolls should mean for Alsperia. Edmon hears the witnesses before deciding how the knowledge may be kept.

beats.speaker: Captain Rovan
beats.text: The western road can be guarded, but soldiers cannot decide what a world-crossing spell is for. That choice belongs to the crown and its scholars.

beats.speaker: Queen Alisande
beats.text: Edmon and I will keep the scrolls under joint court seal. Their study must answer to the people who could be harmed by their use.

routes.text: The court keeps the western road open to supervised scholars and travellers.
The court restricts access to the scrolls until Edmon and Alisande hear a clear purpose for their use.

chapters.title: V. The Eastern Academy — Observatory Courtyard
chapters.narration: In the later reign, academy wardens have evacuated the observatory court. Their instruments record a pulse beneath the lecture vault.

beats.speaker: Warden Celene
beats.text: The breach repeats the king's last spoken thought. The ward lines hold, but the eastern stair is beginning to bend inward.

beats.speaker: Magister Vael
beats.text: I marked the pulse in the courtyard slate. The vault below answers in the same rhythm; we should descend before the next surge.

routes.text: Celene's reinforced ward gives the party a narrow window to descend before the next surge.
Celene's pulse record may explain how the echo repeats. The party carries the pattern into the vault.

chapters.title: V. The Eastern Academy
chapters.narration: Much later, Algoreth is Wizard King of Alsperia. Alisande is now his wife and co-ruler. The surviving record leaves the years between their early court and this reign unwritten. Magister Vael reports a disturbance beneath the eastern academy.

beats.speaker: Magister Vael
beats.text: Before dawn, the old observatory annex changed. Light bent, glyphs shifted, and voices answered from the sealed lecture vault.

beats.speaker: Queen Alisande
beats.text: The wardens will hold the perimeter. Go carefully, my love. Whatever speaks below already knows your voice.

routes.text: Celene's reinforced ward gives the party time to reach the false echo before the next surge.
The pulse record points toward the false echo. The party carries it below for comparison.

beats.speaker: Algoreth
beats.text: A false version of me waits inside the Tear. I will give the breach a boundary instead of feeding it more force.

beats.speaker: Algoreth
beats.text: Power shall endure only in form. Form shall endure only in purpose. Purpose shall endure only where being does not devour itself.

journal.text: The false Algoreth spoke from the academy Tear. Algoreth sealed the breach with a boundary of form and purpose; the false self remains contained.

chapters.title: VI. The Living Record
chapters.narration: The Tear of Chaos is sealed, and the false Algoreth remains within it. The king, Alisande and Ealdrin descend to the Deep Archives to learn whether other Tears exist.

beats.speaker: Ealdrin
beats.text: The living record has no title. It speaks of extraordinary powers questioning their limits, and something that answers the question.

beats.speaker: Queen Alisande
beats.text: If the Tear has a counterpart, we need scholars, warders and maps before we leave. I will not let you face it alone.

beats.speaker: Ealdrin
beats.text: An archive account warns that forcing a Tear shut can make the sealer its anchor. We should compare the signs in Eldrador.

chapters.title: VI. The Living Record — Index Hall
chapters.narration: Past the public shelves, the Archive Index Hall keeps accounts too fragile for ordinary catalogues. Ealdrin asks Algoreth to choose how the record should be carried toward Eldrador.

beats.speaker: Archivist Selene
beats.text: The index names a sealed account and a living witness. I can copy the account, or keep the original here while Ealdrin questions me.

beats.speaker: Ealdrin
beats.text: We have enough to prepare for the journey. The record should guide our questions, not decide what the Tear means.

routes.text: Selene makes a travel copy of the sealed account. Ealdrin will compare its language with the Eldrador signs.
Selene keeps the sealed account in the archive. Ealdrin will rely on a witness statement and ask questions in Eldrador.

journal.text: The Deep Archive account connects Tears with powers confronting their own limits. Alisande and Ealdrin prepare to compare the record with the Eldrador signs.

chapters.title: VII. The Eldrador Expedition
chapters.narration: Queen Vaelthira of Eldrador has found another unstable Tear in her lower sanctuary. Algoreth and his companions prepare an Aethercraft to investigate. What awaits them there remains unknown.

beats.speaker: Queen Vaelthira
beats.text: Our sanctuary's Tear speaks with a familiar voice. I ask you to see it, not to destroy it blindly.

journal.text: Queen Vaelthira invites the party to investigate another unstable Tear. Its outcome is not known.

beats.speaker: Seraphina Everglow
beats.text: I have the ward diagrams ready. Your Majesty, the Aethercraft can carry the court's instruments and scholars.

beats.speaker: Alistair
beats.text: The vessel is ready. The magic knights will guard the academy while you are away.

beats.speaker: Queen Alisande
beats.text: Eldrador has invited us. We go together, and we return with the truth we can find.

chapters.title: VII. The Eldrador Expedition — Aethercraft Hangar
chapters.narration: The Aethercraft waits in the hangar beneath the skyport. Seraphina has room for one final preparation before Queen Vaelthira’s invitation becomes a voyage.

beats.speaker: Flight Marshal Aven
beats.text: We can tune the ship for a quiet approach or load the warding instruments first. Either way, the sanctuary remains unknown until we arrive.

beats.speaker: Seraphina Everglow
beats.text: The crew is ready. We leave with questions, records, and room to change our minds when we see the Tear.

routes.text: The crew prioritizes quiet observation. The Aethercraft carries the copied archive account and keeps its warding array in reserve.
The crew prioritizes protective wards. The Aethercraft leaves the archive account in the court vault and prepares for a guarded arrival.

journal.text: The Aethercraft is prepared to depart. The chosen records and protective measures will shape the approach; the Tear itself remains unknown.
